translationRepairs: This chapter treats Ku'erchan, Ying'e'erdai, Mandarhan, Ming'andali, and others. E Erdeni, of the Nara clan, came from a family long established at Duying'e.
Ku'erchan (younger brother Kubai), Ying'e'erdai, Mandarhan (younger brother Mafuta), Ming'andali. Erdeni, of the Nara clan, came from a family long established at Duying'e.
Restores the heading list including Kubai and Mafuta; the name is Erdeni, not "E Erdeni".
In the sixteenth year of Taizu's uprising, on the first day of the second month of jihai (1599), he called Bakshi E Erdeni, Jarguci, and Gai to create a national script.
In the sixteenth year of Taizu's uprising, on the first day of the second month of jihai (1599), he called Bakshi Erdeni and Jarguci Gai to create a national script.
扎爾固齊 is Gai's title; the name is Erdeni.
E Erdeni and Gai pleaded that long habit in the Mongol script made reform difficult.
Erdeni and Gai pleaded that long habit in the Mongol script made reform difficult.
E Erdeni and Gai asked for a method of reform. The emperor said: "That is not difficult.
Erdeni and Gai asked for a method of reform. The emperor said: "That is not difficult.
When Ming commander Zhang Chengyin marched from Guangning against the army, E Erdeni and other generals counterattacked and killed him.
When Ming commander Zhang Chengyin marched from Guangning against the army, Erdeni and other generals counterattacked and killed him.
By Taizong's reign E Erdeni was already dead; the emperor once told the Literary Bureau he had been a man of rare talent.
By Taizong's reign Erdeni was already dead; the emperor once told the Literary Bureau he had been a man of rare talent.
His son Sahalian became Champion of the Imperial Procession Guard; on embassy he received the surname Heseri and was enrolled in Grand Secretary Xifu's clan.
His son Sahalian became Champion of the Imperial Procession Guard; he was granted the surname Hešeri and was enrolled in Grand Secretary Xifu's clan.
使 is causative, not an embassy.
In the intercalary eleventh month of guisi he and Eidu and Anfiyanggu led a thousand men against the Nain Foduhe stockade and killed its chief Suwensaikeashi.
In the intercalary eleventh month of guisi he and Eidu and Anfiyanggu led a thousand men against the Nain Foduhe stockade and killed its chief Suwen Saikeshi.
搜穩寨克什 reads Suwen Saikeshi.
In the first month of wuxu he, Cuying, Bayara, and Fei Yingdong led a thousand men against Antuhalaku and took more than twenty forts.
In the first month of wuxu he, Taiji Cuyen, Bayara, and Fei Yingdong led a thousand men against Anchulaku and took more than twenty forts.
台吉褚英 is Taiji Cuyen. 安褚拉庫 is Anchulaku.
In Tiancong 8, on the Ming campaign, Wushan and Ashan commanded the rear, set an ambush as directed, routed the enemy, and received third-rank jalan rank.
In Tiancong 8, on the Ming campaign, Wushan and Ashan commanded the rear, set an ambush as directed, routed the enemy, and was made third-class jalan janggin.
三等甲喇章京 is the third-class jalan janggin rank.
In Chongde 1, when Ming troops struck the coastal salt fields, Wushan and Ji'enha were sent in relief and repulsed them.
In Chongde 1, when Ming troops struck the coastal salt fields, Wushan and Ji'enha, vice minister of the Board of Personnel, were sent in relief and repulsed them.
In the eighth month he became vice commissioner of Works.
In the eighth month he became vice minister of the Board of Works.
工部參政 is vice minister of the Board of Works.
Under Taizong he received bayara jalan rank and a niru captaincy.
Under Taizong he was made bayara jalan janggin and a niru captaincy.
巴牙喇甲喇章京 is the bayara jalan janggin office.
He later guarded the bayara standard and sat among the Deliberative Ministers.
He soon became acting bayara tui janggin and sat among the Deliberative Ministers.
護巴牙喇纛章京 is an office.
In Chongde 5 he joined the Ming campaign, besieged Jinzhou, and routed Xingshan's horsemen.
In Chongde 5 he joined the Ming campaign, besieged Jinzhou, and routed the cavalry at Xingshan.
In year 8 he again joined the Ming campaign and took Qian and Zhongqian stations.
In year 8 he again joined the Ming campaign and took Qiantun and Zhongqiansuo.
前屯衛 and 中前所.
At the founding of Shunzhi he entered the pass and received a hereditary niru command.
Early in Shunzhi he entered the pass and received a hereditary niru command.
順治初 means early in the Shunzhi reign.
In year 17 he became Guard deputy commander and assistant captain.
In year 17 he became Guard colonel and company captain.
佐領 is a company captain (niru janggin), not an assistant.
In Kangxi 13 he followed Xiergen against Geng Jingzhong, besieged Fuzhou, repeatedly routed the rebels, and they fled the city.
In Kangxi 13 he followed Dingnan General Xiergen against Geng Jingzhong, besieged Fuzhou, repeatedly routed the rebels, and they fled the city.
定南將軍 title omitted in translation.
In year 19 he led Huguang forces to Guangxi to assist Prince Jian Labu against Ma Chengguang, took Wuning and Xiangzhou, besieged Liuzhou until Chengguang surrendered, and recovered Qingyuan.
In year 19 he led Huguang forces to Guangxi to assist Prince Jian Labu against Ma Chengyin, took Wuning and Xiangzhou, besieged Liuzhou until Chengyin surrendered, and recovered Qingyuan.
馬承廕 reads Ma Chengyin. 承廕 reads Chengyin.
Surrendered generals Meng Qiaofang, Yang Wenkui, and Yang Shengyuan were received through Prince Abatai; Dahai comforted them in Chinese.
Surrendered generals Meng Qiaofang, Yang Wenkui, and Yang Shengyuan were received through Beile Abatai; Dahai comforted them in Chinese.
貝勒 is beile, not prince.
When the translations were completed that year he received guerrilla rank.
When the translations were completed that year he was made youji (major).
游擊 is the youji military rank.
Dahai refined the national script, completing E Erdeni and Gai's work and expanding it to twelve syllabic heads.
Dahai refined the national script, completing Erdeni and Gai's work and expanding it to twelve syllabic heads.
Fourth son Changer became bachelor after Yaqin's death; grandson Chanbu petitioned for Dahai's stele.
Fourth son Chang'e was made academician after Yaqin's death; grandson Chanbu petitioned for Dahai's stele.
常額 reads Chang'e; 學士 is academician.
A later proposal to enshrine Dahai in Confucius's temple was rejected by Rites Minister Han Tan.
A later proposal by Directorate of Education Chancellor Alihu to enshrine Dahai in Confucius's temple was rejected by Rites Minister Han Tan.
阿理瑚 and his office were omitted.
at Tiancong's opening he rose to first-rank attendant. Ashadahan gave him twenty edicts; he passed them to followers and lost nine.
at Tiancong's opening he rose to first-rank attendant. Ashidarhan gave him twenty edicts; he passed them to followers and lost nine.
With Ashadahan he proclaimed amnesty across Khorchin, Barin, Jarud, and Khalkha and cleared prisons.
With Ashidarhan he proclaimed amnesty across Khorchin, Barin, Jarud, and Kharachin and cleared prisons.
阿什達爾漢 reads Ashidarhan. 喀喇沁 is Kharachin, not Khalkha.
When Haqitai chief Elin submitted, Nikan was sent to welcome him.
When Hauchit taiji Elin submitted, Nikan was sent to welcome him.
蒿齊忒部台吉 is the Hauchit taiji.
Prince Zheng Jirhala, guarding the capital, sent Nikan with Guarcia and
Prince Zheng Jirgalang, guarding the capital, sent Nikan with Guarcia and
In year 9 at Guihua he helped Yueto seize four Ming and ten Tumed envoys colluding on the border.
In year 9 at Guihua he and Colonel Arjin, sent by Yoto, seized four Ming and ten Tumed envoys colluding on the border.
岳託 is Yoto; 參領阿爾津 omitted.
In year 4, when Mongol levies fell short, he was sent to rebuke Khorchin, Khalkha, and Tumed.
In year 4, when Mongol levies fell short, he was sent to rebuke Khorchin, Kharachin, and Tumed.
喀喇沁 is Kharachin, not Khalkha.
In Shunzhi 2 he followed Yoto into Henan and led Mongols from Nanyang toward Guide.
In Shunzhi 2 he followed Dodo, Prince Yu, into Henan and led Mongols from Nanyang toward Guide.
豫親王多鐸 is Dodo, not Yoto.
In year 3 he followed Duo Duo against the Sunite and crushed them, reaching ashanihafan.
In year 3 he followed Dodo against the Sunite and crushed them, reaching ashanihafan.
Nailuhun had governed Hada; Suotanlan submitted with his people.
Lailuhun had governed Hada; Suotanlan submitted with his people.
and Liu Xingzuo were sent to proclaim terms.
and Vice Commander Liu Xingzuo were sent to proclaim terms.
In the fourth year's first month Ku'erchan and Gao Hongzhong opened Luanzhou by stratagem and the army entered.
In the fourth year's first month Ku'erchan and Youji Gao Hongzhong opened Luanzhou by stratagem and the army entered.
In the fifth month Zhang Chun attacked; Ku'erchan
In the fifth month Ming army-supervising intendant Zhang Chun attacked; Ku'erchan
with Jueshan sallied, crossed the moat, and charged the enemy.
with Niru Ejen Jueshan sallied, crossed the moat, and charged the enemy.
Isolated at Yongping as Turgut withdrew, Ku'erchan
Isolated at Yongping as Lieutenant-General Turge and others withdrew, Ku'erchan
都統圖爾格 is Lieutenant-General Turge.
He followed Amin in abandoning the cities and returned to await punishment.
He followed Beile Amin in abandoning the cities and returned to await punishment.
received the letter, saw the corpse, mourned as for Xingzuo, had his son inherit, and arranged burial.
received the letter, saw the corpse, mourned as for Xingzuo, had his son Wushi inherit, and arranged burial.
五十 is the son's name.
Abatai and Jirhala were sent with five hundred men after him.
Beile Abatai and Jirgalang were sent with five hundred men after him.
Abatai and Jirhala trapped him; Tulushi captured and killed Xingzuo and took Xingxian.
Abatai and Jirgalang trapped him; Jalan Ejen Tulushi captured and killed Xingzuo and took Xingxian.
濟爾哈朗 reads Jirgalang; 甲喇額真 omitted.
Xingzhi held Pidao while brothers served as officers.
Xingzhi held Pidao while brothers Xingji, Xingliang, Xingpei and Xingbang served as officers.
Envoys summoned Xingzhi, claiming border troops had mistakenly killed Xingzuo;
Xingpei held Changshan Island as youji. Envoys summoned Xingzhi, claiming border troops had mistakenly killed Xingzuo;
At Yanjing he received a grand minister's residence and slaves.
When Shizu established the capital at Yanjing, his household received a grand minister's residence and slaves.
世祖定鼎 omitted; Ku'erchan was already dead.
That seventh month he became Personnel vice commissioner when the Six Boards opened.
That seventh month he became vice minister of the Board of Personnel when the Six Boards opened.
吏部參政 is vice minister.
In year 6 at Shenyang he received guerrilla rank.
In year 6 at Shenyang he was made youji.
游擊 is the youji rank.
After Liaoyang he became second-rank vice commander.
After Liaoyang he became second-class canjiang (assistant regional commander).
二等參將 is a second-class canjiang.
In year 7 he requisitioned Korean grain for Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming; Korea refused citing old enmity with Mao.
In year 7 he and Youji Luo Qi requisitioned Korean grain for Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming; King Li Jong sent his minister Pak Rok in reply, refusing and citing old enmity with Mao.
羅奇 omitted. 李倧 and 樸祿 omitted.
Sent again with Dai Song'a, he secured the grain.
Sent again with Beiyu Dai Song'a, he secured the grain.
Taizong campaigned against Chahar; Lind Khan fled and his followers scattered.
Taizong campaigned against Chahar; Ligdan Khan fled to Tibet and his followers scattered.
林丹汗 is Ligdan Khan; 圖白特 omitted.
Captives reported a thousand homeless households; he and Buerji tracked them with two thousand men.
Captives reported a thousand homeless households; he and Meiren Ejen Gioro Burgi tracked them with two thousand men.
覺羅布爾吉 is Gioro Burgi, a meiren ejen.
In year 5 Jong's fortifications and stores drew rebuke via Edict; he apologized.
In year 5 Jong's fortifications and stores drew rebuke via an edict carried by Ying'e'erdai and Omoktu; he apologized.
英俄爾岱及鄂莫克圖 omitted.
In year 6 at Jinzhou and Songshan he served throughout the campaigns.
In year 6, when Dorgon attacked Jinzhou and Beile Dodo besieged Songshan, he served throughout the campaigns.
Commanders 多爾袞 and 多鐸 omitted.
He married Abatai's daughter and became Prince Consort.
He married Abatai's daughter (Prince Raoyu) and became a Doro efu.
饒餘郡王 omitted; 多羅額駙 is Doro efu.
Under Oboi's dictatorship, kinship with Sunahai brought retroactive charges and loss of office.
Under Oboi's dictatorship, kinship with Grand Secretary Sunahai, whom Oboi had put to death, brought retroactive charges and loss of office.
大學士 and his execution omitted.
In the seventh month he became Rites vice commissioner.
In the seventh month he became vice minister of the Board of Rites.
禮部參政 is vice minister.
In year 8 at Datong he took four forts, one platform, and Wangjiazhuang.
In year 8, when Taizong attacked Datong, Mandarhan took four forts, one platform, and Wangjiazhuang.
He soon became chief of the Board of Rites.
禮部承政 is chief of the Board of Rites.
In Chongde 2 he followed Ajige, took Pidao, and received gold, furs, and horses.
In Chongde 2 he followed Ajige, Prince Wuying,, took Pidao, and received gold, furs, and horses.
In Tiancong 5 he became Revenue vice commissioner.
In Tiancong 5 he became vice minister of the Board of Revenue.
戶部參政 is vice minister.
In the fifth month he stayed to guard with Jirhala while Taizong campaigned.
In the fifth month he stayed to guard with Beile Jirgalang while Taizong campaigned.
In year 9 he went to Korea with Boerhui.
In year 9 he went to Korea with Vice Minister Borhui.
參政博爾惠 is Vice Minister Borhui.
In the sixth month collusion with Prince Shuotuo and private gain on the Korea campaign brought a capital sentence commuted to fine.
In the sixth month taking his son along for booty and collusion with Beizi Shoto and private gain on the Korea campaign brought a capital sentence commuted to fine.
貝子碩託 is Beizi Shoto; son clause omitted.
In the third year's seventh month he became left Revenue vice commissioner.
In the third year's seventh month he became left vice minister of the Board of Revenue.
戶部左參政 is left vice minister.
In the fourth year's sixth month he invested Lady Zhao as queen.
In the fourth year's sixth month he and Bahana, vice minister of Punishments, invested Jong's consort Lady Zhao as queen.
巴哈納 and 倧妃 omitted.
In the eighth month brother Fu'erdan's retreat cost him his life; his estate went to Mafuta.
In the eighth month his elder brother, Jalan Ejen Fu'erdan, was executed for retreating; his estate went to Mafuta.
In the eleventh month Jong sought a stele at Sandu Ferry; Mafuta and Chaohar were sent to inspect.
In the eleventh month Jong sought a stele at Sandu Ferry; Mafuta and Vice Minister of Rites Chaohar were sent to inspect.
In Tiancong 1 he died at Jinzhou; Ming'andali inherited guerrilla rank and the niru.
In Tiancong 1 he died at Jinzhou; Ming'andali inherited hereditary youji rank and the niru.
With Prince Yueto he breached the wall near Miyun, defeated Feng Yongsheng, and took Nanhe.
With Beile Yoto he breached the wall near Miyun, and with Gusai Ejen Ibai defeated the eunuch Feng Yongsheng, and took Nanhe.
岳託 is Beile Yoto; 伊拜 and 太監 omitted.
With Ashan he defeated Ming from Sanhe and raided Shandong.
With Gabsihiyan Galai Amban Ashan he defeated Ming from Sanhe and raided Shandong.
噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦 title omitted.
At Luoshan and with Oboi against Fan Zhiwan he repeatedly defeated Ming.
At Luoshan against regional commanders Bai Guang'en, Zhang Dengke and He Yingjian, and with Bayara Tui Janggin Oboi against Supreme Commander Fan Zhiwan, he repeatedly defeated Ming.
He became Rites vice commissioner and Plain White Mongol meiren commander.
He became vice minister of the Board of Rites and Plain White Mongol meiren commander.
禮部參政 is vice minister.
In year 2 he followed Ajige west and won seven battles at Yan'an.
In year 2 he followed Ajige, Prince Ying, west and won seven battles at Yan'an.
Against Sunite rebel Tengjisi he followed Duo Duo and held strategic passes.
Against Sunite rebel Tengjisi he followed Dodo, Prince Yu, and held strategic passes.
豫親王多鐸 is Dodo, Prince Yu.
He night-pursued Tengjisi to Zhuge Tekeshan, killed Taiji Maohai, and with Wakeda chased north, killing eleven men himself.
He night-pursued Tengjisi to Otek Mountain, killed Taiji Maohai, and with General Who Guards the State Wakeda chased north, killing eleven men himself.
諸鄂特克山: 及諸 = caught them at Otek Mountain. 鎮國將軍 title omitted.
He also defeated the Tushatu and Shuolei khans.
He also defeated the Tüsheet and Shuolei khans.
土謝圖汗 is the Tüsheet Khan.
At Sanshan Gorge he destroyed Yang Wenying's fleet and drove Chenggong to sea.
At Sanshan Gorge he attacked Yang Wenying's fleet of over a thousand boats, killed a deputy general, seized the boats and siege gear, and drove Chenggong to sea.
Details of 斬副將一，獲其舟及諸攻具 omitted.
Campaign merit against Galdan brought toshalahafan combined as third ashanihafan.
Duke's campaign merit against Galdan brought toshalahafan combined as third ashanihafan.
Grandson Yong'an inherited at first adahafan with toshalahafan.
Duke's grandson Yong'an inherited at first adahafan with toshalahafan.
Yong'an's line through Xiande and Menglin has separate biographies.
Yong'an's grandson Xiande and Xiande's son Menglin have separate biographies.
Kinship of 孫憲德 and 子夢麟 omitted.
From Mongol letters came the national script: E Erdeni and Gai began it, Dahai perfected it.
From Mongol letters came the national script: Erdeni and Gai began it, Dahai perfected it.
He died in year 8 with posthumous name Mingguo.
He died in year 8 with posthumous name Minguo.
